name: ysk-throttle
description: Cuts the cost of Claude Code's built-in 'You should know' side agent by letting its routine checks through only every N tool calls, and never on an expired cache

minToolCalls.title: Tool calls between checks
minToolCalls.description: Main-conversation tool calls that must run before the next routine check is let through (the plugin's own cadence is every 6 model calls).

staleMinutes.title: Skip checks after an idle gap (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: Skip a check when the step before it came more than this long after the previous one: the conversation's prompt cache has likely expired, and the check would pay the whole conversation at full price. Claude subscriptions typically write 1-hour cache entries; API keys default to 5 minutes, so set 4 there.
